technical_and_design_decisions: Target Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
Implement Ambari plugin support by extending the existing Spring XD deployment mechanisms to integrate with Apache Ambari APIs.
Integrate Spring Cloud Config server natively into spring-bus modules to externalize properties.
For SI 4.2 channel performance, add instrumentation and logging to identify bottlenecks, followed by targeted optimizations.
Implement baseline serialization measurement using JMH (Java Microbenchmark Harness) for XD.
Support `fsUri = file://` by modifying the Hadoop FileSystem configuration logic in the jdbchdfs job to correctly resolve local file schemes.
Pass system properties to Sqoop jobs using ProcessBuilder environment setup.
assumptions: The developer is highly experienced with Spring Framework, Spring XD, Spring Integration, and Hadoop ecosystems.
Access to a fully functional test environment for YARN, Hadoop, and Apache Ambari is available.
Existing CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks are in place and do not require significant setup time.
The scope of 'investigation' and 'review' includes implementing necessary code changes or architectural adjustments based on findings.
No major architectural rewrites are needed, only targeted enhancements and configurations.

activities.activity_description: Analyze U1-U8, design the technical approach for Ambari integration, Spring Cloud Config, LocalFileSystem support, and Sqoop properties.

activities.activity_name: Ambari Plugin for Spring XD on YARN
activities.activity_description: Implement the option to support Apache Ambari installed Spring XD on YARN and upgrade from 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA using the Ambari plugin (U1, U6).
Integrate spring-cloud-config server for spring-bus modules and review/adjust the spring-bus architecture to address foundation level gaps (U2, U5).
Investigate channel performance issues in Spring Integration 4.2, identify bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions (U3).
Measure baseline serialization characteristics in Spring XD to determine areas of performance improvements (U4).
Implement support for fsUri = file:// to use Hadoop LocalFileSystem instead of a running cluster in jdbchdfs jobs (U7).
Add the option to specify system properties passed to the Sqoop job running in its own Java process (U8).
Write documentation for upgrading Spring XD from 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA using the Ambari plugin and other new features (U6).
Unit, integration, and performance testing for all implemented features and bug fixes.
Prepare the release bits, finalize the GA upgrade, and deploy to staging/production environments.
